q: Alex said that he had finished his homework long before. (Change the narration)
o: Alex said, "I had finished my homework long ago."
Alex said, "I finished my homework long before."
Alex said, "I finished my homework long ago."
Alex said, "I finish my homework long ago."

q: Dipti said to me "Are you reading now?" (Make it indirect)
o: Dipti said me whether I was reading then.
Dipti asked me whether I was reading then.
Dipti said me if I am reading then.
Dipti asked to me whether I am reading then.

q: He said that he ____ attend the class. Use correct form of tense in the blank.
o: will
would
shall
may
e:
‘He said that…’ বাক্যে মূল verb said, অর্থাৎ Past Tense-এ আছে। নিয়ম হলো, মূল verb past হলে that-এর পরের clause-এর modal verb-ও past form-এ যায়। Will-এর past form would, তাই সঠিক বাক্য He said that he would attend the class। এটি আসলে Indirect speech-এর নিয়ম, কারণ সরাসরি উক্তিতে সে বলেছিল ‘I will attend the class’।
Shall ভবিষ্যৎ বোঝায়, কিন্তু সাধারণ ব্যবহারে এটি প্রথম পুরুষের (I, we) সঙ্গে বসে, আর এখানে ‘he’ আছে। May বসালে অর্থ হয় সম্ভাবনা, যা বাক্যের ভাবের সঙ্গে মেলে না।
মনে রাখুন: Indirect speech-এ will → would, can → could, may → might, shall → should।
s: দ্য সিকিউরিটি প্রিন্টিং কর্পোরেশন (বাংলাদেশ), সহকারী ব্যবস্থাপক (২০২১)

q: He said to me, “Did you take the examination?” The indirect form is:
o: He asked me did I take the examination
He asked to me if I took the examination
He asked me if I had given the examination
He asked me if I had taken the examination
e: Yes/no প্রশ্নে indirect-এ if বা whether বসে। Past indefinite (did take) বদলে past perfect (had taken) হয়, আর you হয় I। তাই “He asked me if I had taken the examination”। প্রথম অপশনে প্রশ্নের ক্রম রয়ে গেছে, দ্বিতীয়টিতে asked to me ভুল (asked-এর পরে to হয় না), আর তৃতীয়টিতে take-এর বদলে give বসে অর্থ বদলে গেছে।

q: He said, "What a pity" বাক্যের Indirect speech-
o: He said that it was a great pity
He exclaimed that it was a great pity
He exclaimed that it is great pity
The exclaimed that it is a great pity
e: Exclamatory sentence-এ said বদলে exclaimed বসে এবং 'What a' বদলে 'a great' হয়। Reporting verb অতীত কালে, তাই is হবে was: He exclaimed that it was a great pity।

q: Nobody knew that he ___ face a crisis
o: can
may
will
would
e: Knew অতীত, তাই পরের clause-এ অতীতের দৃষ্টিকোণে ভবিষ্যৎ বোঝাতে would বসে। তাই he would face a crisis সঠিক। অর্থ: কেউ জানত না যে সে সংকটে পড়বে। Can, may ও will বর্তমান রূপ, যা অতীতের main verb-এর সাথে মেলে না। Main verb অতীত হলে modal-ও অতীত হয়: will→would, can→could, may→might।

q: He has said to me, “I shall go out but you will stay.” Make it indirect speech.
o: He has told me that he would go out but I should stay
He has told me that he will go out but I shall stay
He told me that he will go out but I shall stay
He has said me that he would go out but I would stay
e: Reporting verb present perfect (has said) হলে reported speech-এর tense বদলায় না, শুধু person বদলায়। Said to হয়ে যায় told, তাই “has told me”। “I shall go” এর I হয় he, আর “you will stay” এর you হয় আমি (me-এর person অনুযায়ী) I। ফলে সঠিক রূপ: He has told me that he will go out but I shall stay। অর্থ: সে আমাকে বলেছে সে বাইরে যাবে কিন্তু আমি থাকব।

q: Himu says, I have done my duty.” (make it indirect)
o: Himu says that he had done his duty.
Himu says that he has done his duty.
Himu tells that he had done his duty.
Himu tells that he has done his duty.

q: She said that she had done her assigned work. (Make it direct)
o: She said to me, 'She did her assigned work.'
She said, "I did my assigned work."
She said, "I have done my assigned work."
She said, "She had done her assigned work"

q: He said to her, "What do you want?" বাক্যটির indirect speech হবে-
o: He asked her what she wanted.
He told her what did she want.
He asked her what did she wanted.
He asked her what does she want.
e: প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্যের indirect speech-এ reporting verb 'said to' বদলে 'asked' হয় এবং reported অংশ প্রশ্নের গঠন হারিয়ে সাধারণ বিবৃতির রূপ নেয়। Wh-question হলে wh-শব্দটিই সংযোজক থাকে, তারপর subject ও verb বসে, তাই 'what she wanted'। Reporting verb অতীতে থাকায় 'want' হয় 'wanted', আর 'you' হয় 'she'। খ ও গ-তে 'did she' রেখে প্রশ্নের গঠন থেকে গেছে, গ-তে আবার did-এর পরে wanted বসানো ব্যাকরণগত ভুল। ঘ-তে tense বদলানো হয়নি। Yes/no প্রশ্ন হলে সংযোজক হয় if বা whether, যেমন He asked her if she was ready.

q: Rupa said, "I must finish my homework." (Make it indirect)
o: Rupa said that she must finished her homework.
Rupa said that she had to be finished her homework.
Rupa said that she had to finish her homework.
Rupa said that she has to finish her homework.

q: The captain said to the soldiers, "March forward." [indirect]
o: The captain ordered the soldiers that march forward.
The captain ordered the soldiers to march forward.
The captain told to the soldiers that they march forward.
The captain requested the soldiers to march forward.

q: My brother said to me, "You had better stay home." [indirect]
o: My brother advised me to stay home.
My brother ordered me that I had better stay home
My brother proposed me to stay home.
My brother advised that I stayed home.

q: The Captain said to the soldiers, "Stand still." (Change the narration)
o: The Captain told the soldiers stand still.
The Captain said the soldiers to stand still.
The Captain commanded the soldiers to stand still.

q: The prisoner strongly desired that he had the wings of a dove. (Make it direct.)
o: The prisoner said, “Had I the wings of a dove!”
The prisoner told, “I have the wings of a dove.”
The prisoner said in joy, “He had the wings of a dove”
The prisoner said, “Have I the wings of a dove?”
e: Indirect বাক্যে desired that he had... প্রবল ইচ্ছা প্রকাশ করছে, তাই direct-এ ইচ্ছাসূচক বিস্ময়বাক্য বসে। এমন ইচ্ছা Had I ... ! বা Oh, that I had ... ! আকারে লেখা হয়। বাক্যের অর্থ: আহা, যদি আমার ঘুঘুর মতো ডানা থাকত! বাকি অপশনে বিবৃতি বা প্রশ্ন বসায় ইচ্ছার ভাব হারিয়ে গেছে।

The headmistress says that the school would remain closed the next day.
The headmistress says that the school will be remain closed the next day.

q: The manager said to the clerk, "Why were you late yesterday?" (make it indirect)
o: The manager told the clerk why he have been late the day before.
The manager asked the clerk why he had been late the day before.
The manager asked the clerk why he have been late the day before.

q: Choose the correct indirect speech: Father said to me, "May you be happy."
o: Father told me that I may be happy.
Father asked me to be happy.
Father prayed that I might be happy.
Father said that I was happy.
e:
May দিয়ে শুরু বাক্য আশীর্বাদ বা প্রার্থনা বোঝায়, তাই Reporting Verb হয় prayed বা wished। May হয় might এবং শ্রোতার you হয় I। তাই Father prayed that I might be happy। এটি Optative Sentence-এর Indirect।
মনে রাখুন:
May God bless you → He prayed that God might bless me।

q: He said, "The horse died in the night." (make it indirect speech)
o: He said that the horse has died in the night.
He said that the horse was died in the night.
He said that the horse had died in the night.

q: The president said, "May our country prosper." (Change into indirect speech)
o: The president told that their country should prosper.
The president wished that their country might prosper.

q: Nasima said, “What a fine picture it is!” (Change into indirect speech.)
o: Nasima said that it is a very fine picture
Nasima exclaimed that it was a very fine picture
Nasima exclaimed that it is a very fine picture
Nasima exclaimed that what a fine picture it was
e: What a ... দিয়ে আবেগ প্রকাশ হলে indirect-এ reporting verb হয় exclaimed, আর What a fine picture হয় a very fine picture। Is বদলে was হয়, কারণ reporting verb past। তাই “Nasima exclaimed that it was a very fine picture” (নাসিমা বিস্ময়ে বলল ছবিটি খুবই সুন্দর)। শুধু said লিখলে আবেগ হারায়, ‘it is’ কাল বদলায়নি, আর ‘what a fine picture’ রেখে দেওয়া ভুল।

q: She asked me, 'Are you happy in your new job?'
o: She asked me if I was happy in my new job
She asked me if I have been happy in my new job
She asked me whether I am happy in my new job
She asked me if I had been happy in my new job
e: Yes/No প্রশ্নের indirect রূপে if/whether বসে এবং reporting verb past হওয়ায় are হয়ে যায় was। you হয় I এবং your হয় my।
s: প্রাথমিক শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর, প্রাক-প্রাথমিক সহকারী শিক্ষক (মুক্তিযোদ্ধা কোটা) (২০১৬)

q: Choose the correct indirect speech of: "Why did she leave early?"
o: He asked why did she leave early.
He asked why she had left early.
He asked why was she leaving early.
He asked why had she left early.

q: He said, "What a pity!" বাক্যটির indirect speech হবে-
o: He said that it was a great pity
He exclaimed that it is a great pity
He exclaimed that it was a great pity
He exclaimed that it is great pity
e: Exclamatory বাক্যে said বদলে exclaimed হয় এবং 'What a' বদলে 'a great' বসে। Reporting verb অতীতে থাকায় is বদলে was হবে: He exclaimed that it was a great pity।
s: প্রাথমিক শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর, সহকারী শিক্ষক (হেমন্ত; মুক্তিযোদ্ধাদের সন্তানদের জন্য বিশেষ) (২০১০)

q: We use a ___ before the indirect speech.
o: linker
article
adjective
preposition
e: Direct থেকে indirect speech করার সময় reporting verb ও reported speech-কে জোড়া লাগাতে একটি যোজক বসে, সাধারণত that। একে এখানে linker বলা হয়েছে, কারণ এটি দুটি অংশকে সংযুক্ত করে। যেমন: He said, “I am ill.” → He said that he was ill. প্রশ্নবাচক বাক্যে if/whether এবং Wh-প্রশ্নে সেই Wh-শব্দই linker-এর কাজ করে।

q: Father said to his son, "May the sun shine brightly on your special day." (Make it indirect)
o: Father wished that the sun may shine brightly on his son's special day.
Father wished that the sun might shine brightly on his son's special day.

None of these

q: She said to him, "Where do you live?"(make it indirect)
o: She told him where he lived.
She told him where he lives.
She asked him where he lives.
She asked him where he lived.

q: He said, "I went to Khulna". The indirect speech is—
o: He said that he went to Khulna
He said that he had gone to Khulna
He said that he has gone to Khulna
He said that he would go to Khulna
e:
Direct speech-এর reporting verb ‘said’ অতীতকালের হলে, indirect speech-এ উদ্ধৃতাংশের tense এক ধাপ পেছনে যায়। উদ্ধৃতাংশ ‘I went to Khulna’ হলো Past Indefinite, তাই indirect-এ সেটি Past Perfect হয়। আবার উত্তম পুরুষ ‘I’ প্রথম বাক্যের subject ‘He’-এর সঙ্গে মিলে ‘he’ হয়। ফলে বাক্যটি দাঁড়ায়: He said that he had gone to Khulna। Past Indefinite থেকে Past Perfect না হলে অতীতের আগের ঘটনা বোঝানো যায় না।
মনে রাখুন:
Present Indefinite → Past Indefinite।
Past Indefinite → Past Perfect।
Will → would।
Can → could।
s: ফরেন সার্ভিস একাডেমি (পররাষ্ট্র মন্ত্রণালয়), প্রশাসনিক ব্যক্তিগত কর্মকর্তা (২০২৫)

q: Asad said to me, “I want to go to school now.” বাক্যটির indirect speech হবে-
o: Asad said to me that he wanted to go to school now.
Asad said to me that he wanted to go to school then.
Asad told me that he wanted to go to school then.
Asad told me that he wants to go to school then.
e: said to বদলে told, I বদলে he, want বদলে wanted এবং now বদলে then হয়। সব পরিবর্তন একসঙ্গে আছে কেবল গ-তে।
s: প্রাথমিক শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর, প্রাক-প্রাথমিক সহকারী শিক্ষক (ঝিলাম) (২০১৩)

q: He said, ‘My friends, listen to me.’ (Direct -Indirect)
o: He told them to listen to his friends.
Addressing him, he told them to listen to him.
Addressing his friends, he told them to listen to him.
Addressing him, his friends told them to listen to him.

q: I said to him, “Will you follow me?” What is the correct indirect form?
o: I said to him if he would follow me
I asked him if he would have follow me
I asked him if he would follow me
I asked him would he follow me
e: Yes/no প্রশ্নে said to বদলে asked বসে এবং যোজক if বা whether আসে। Will বদলে would হয়, you হয় he, me অপরিবর্তিত থাকে (বক্তা নিজেই I)। তাই “I asked him if he would follow me” (আমি তাকে জিজ্ঞেস করলাম সে আমাকে অনুসরণ করবে কিনা)। “Said to him if” ভুল, “would have follow” ব্যাকরণগত ভুল, আর “would he” প্রশ্নের ক্রম বজায় রেখেছে।

q: He said, "Alas! I am ruined." বাক্যটির indirect speech হবে-
o: He exclaimed with sorrow that he is ruined
He exclaimed with sorrow that he was ruined
He exclaimed with sorrow that he has ruined
He exclaimed with sorrow that he has been ruined
e: 'Alas' দুঃখ প্রকাশ করে, তাই 'exclaimed with sorrow' লেখা হয়। Reporting verb past হওয়ায় 'I am' বদলে 'he was' হবে।
s: প্রাথমিক শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর, সহকারী শিক্ষক (হেমন্ত; মুক্তিযোদ্ধাদের সন্তানদের জন্য বিশেষ) (২০১০)

q: He said, “I am busy.”- correct indirect speech is:
o: He said that he was busy.
He said he was busy.
He said he is buysy.
He said that he is busy.

q: Change the narration: They said, "We had not gone to Japan".
o: They said that they had not gone to Japan.
They said that they did not go to Japan.

q: Rina said to him, "Congratulations!" Choose the correct Indirect Narration:
o: Rina says him congratulations.
Rina said congratulations to him.
Rina congratulated him.
Rina congratulates him.

q: He said, “Alas! I am undone.” Find out the correct indirect speech of the sentence.
o: He exclaimed with sorrow that he was undone
He cried out so that he is undone
He was sorry, because he was undone
He expressed his misfortune
e: Alas! শোকসূচক আবেগ প্রকাশ করে, তাই indirect-এ exclaimed with sorrow বসে। Interjection বাদ যায় এবং am বদলে was হয়, কারণ reporting verb past। I বদলে he হয়। সঠিক রূপ: He exclaimed with sorrow that he was undone (সে দুঃখে বলল সে সর্বনাশের মধ্যে পড়েছে)। ‘so that’ ভুল যোজক, আর বাকি অপশন মূল বাক্যের বিবরণ ধরে রাখে না।

q: He said to me, “Why did you come here?” The indirect speech will be:
o: He asked me why I went there
He asked me if I had gone there
He asked me why I had come here
He asked me why I had gone there
e: Wh-প্রশ্নের indirect-এ asked এবং Wh-শব্দ why থাকে, if বসে না। Past indefinite (did come) হয় past perfect (had come/gone)। Here বদলে there হয়, আর বক্তার জায়গা থেকে দূরে বোঝাতে come প্রায়ই go হয়। তাই “He asked me why I had gone there”। if বসালে ধরন ভুল হয়, “why I went” কাল ঠিক নয়, আর এখানে here রাখা যায় না।

q: Make indirect: The boy told the shopkeeper, 'Can you give me a candy please?
o: The boy requested the shopkeeper if he could give him a candy?
The boy said please to the shopkeeper and asked to give him a candy?
The boy said to the shopkeeper if he can give him a candy?
The boy asked the shopkeeper if he can give him a candy?

q: Which of the following is the correct indirect form of the given direct speech: “Who are you and what do you want?” he said to me.
o: He asked me who was I and what did I want
He asked to me who were you and what did you want
He asked me who I was and what I wanted
He told me who you are and what you want
e: দুটি Wh-প্রশ্ন and দিয়ে যুক্ত থাকলে indirect-এ দুটিই বিবৃতির ক্রমে যায়, আর said to বদলে asked বসে। Are বদলে was হয়, do want বদলে wanted হয়, আর you বদলে I হয়। তাই “He asked me who I was and what I wanted”। অন্য অপশনে প্রশ্নের ক্রম রয়ে গেছে, asked to ভুল, বা told ব্যবহার করে প্রশ্নের ধরন নষ্ট হয়েছে।

q: Direct: He said to me, “Have you prepared your lesson?” (make it indirect)
o: He told me if I had prepared my lesson.
He asked me if I had prepared my lesson.
He said to me if I had prepared my lesson.
He ordered me if I had prepared my lesson.

q: Choose the correct indirect speech: “If I were you, I’d wait,” I said.
o: I advised him to wait
I ordered him to wait
I requested him to wait
I told him to wait
e: “If I were you, I would ...” পরামর্শ দেওয়ার প্রচলিত ধরন। Indirect-এ তাই reporting verb advised ব্যবহার হয়, তারপর object ও to-infinitive: advised him to wait। অর্থ: আমি তাকে অপেক্ষা করার পরামর্শ দিলাম। Ordered আদেশ, requested অনুরোধ, আর told সাধারণ বলা বোঝায়, এগুলো পরামর্শের ভাব আনে না।

q: Choose the correct indirect speech. He remarked, "Two and two makes four".
o: He remarked that two and two would make four.
He remarked that two and two made four.
He remarked that two and two makes four.
He remarked that two and two make four.
e:
Indirect Speech-এ সার্বজনীন সত্য বা গাণিতিক সত্য (Universal Truth) থাকলে reporting verb অতীত হলেও reported speech-এর tense বদলায় না। ‘Two and two makes four’ একটি গাণিতিক সত্য, তাই বাক্যটি আগের tense-এই থেকে যায়। অতএব reported speech-এ makes-ই থাকে। অন্য অপশনগুলোয় would make বা made বসে tense বদলে গেছে, আর make বসলে verb-এর রূপ subject-এর সঙ্গে মেলে না। গণিতে ‘two and two’-কে একটি একক যোগফল ধরা হয়, তাই এখানে makes ব্যবহার হয়েছে।
উদাহরণ:
He said, “The earth moves round the sun.” – He said that the earth moves round the sun.
মনে রাখুন: ঐতিহাসিক সত্য ও চিরন্তন সত্যের ক্ষেত্রেও tense পরিবর্তন হয় না।

q: "Are you weeping?" he asked her. The indirect speech of this sentence will be-
o: He asked her that she was weeping.
He asked her if she was weeping.
He asked her that he is weeping.
None of these
e: Yes/No প্রশ্নের indirect speech-এ if বা whether বসে, that নয়। Present Continuous (are weeping) হয় Past Continuous (was weeping) এবং you হয় she। উত্তর 'He asked her if she was weeping.'। অর্থ: সে তাকে জিজ্ঞেস করল সে কাঁদছে কি না। 'asked her that' ভুল, কারণ প্রশ্নে that চলে না। তৃতীয় অপশনে person ও tense দুটোই ভুল। সূত্র: প্রশ্নে if/whether, বিবৃতিতে that।

q: My friend said to me, “Why were you absent from class?”
o: My friend asked me why I was absent from class.
My friend enquired why did I had absented from class.
My friend enquired why did I was absent from class.
My friend asked me why I had been absent from class.

q: Choose the correct narration- Rimu said to her mother, "I shall go to bed now."
o: Rimu told her mother that she would go to bed then.
Rimu told her mother that she should go to bed now.
Rimu told her mother that she will go to bed now.
Rimu told her mother that she will go to bed then.

q: 'I will help Sadia', he said, 'if i can'. (Make it indirect)
o: I would help Sadia, if I could, he said.
He said that he would help Sadia if he could.
He would help Sadia, he said, if he could.
He said if he could he would help Sadia.

q: Rafiq said to me , "I was ill." বাক্যটির indirect speech হবে-
o: Rafiq told me that he has been ill
Rafiq told me that he had been ill
Rafiq told me that I had been ill
Rafiq said to me that he was ill
e: Reporting verb past হলে inverted comma-র ভেতরের past indefinite বদলে past perfect হয় (was → had been); said to বদলে told এবং I বদলে he হয়।

q: Select the indirect form of speech: My father said, "All that glitters is not gold."
o: My father remarked that all that glitters is not gold.
My father advised that all that glitters is not gold.
My father said that all that glitters is not gold.
My father said that all that glitters was not gold.

q: The boss said to the employees, 'Don't waste your time'. (Make it indirect)
o: The boss ordered the employees to not waste their time.
The boss forbade the employees not to waste their time.
The boss advised the employees not to waste their time.
The boss asked the employees to not waste their time.

q: Find out the correct sentence is indirect speech. He said to me, "What are you doing?"
o: He said what was to do.
He said about my doing.
He said to me what I am dong.
He asked me what I was doing.
e:
প্রত্যক্ষ উক্তিতে প্রশ্ন থাকলে পরোক্ষ উক্তিতে said to বদলে asked হয়। প্রশ্ন wh-শব্দ দিয়ে শুরু হলে সেই শব্দই conjunction হিসেবে থাকে, আর বাক্যের গঠন সাধারণ বাক্যের মতো (subject + verb) হয়। Reporting verb অতীত হলে are doing বদলে was doing হয়, আর you বদলে I হয়। তাই He asked me what I was doing। অন্য বিকল্পগুলোর কাঠামো ঠিক নয়।
মনে রাখুন: প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন পরোক্ষ উক্তিতে বসে না।

q: John said to me, 'Thank you' [change the narration]
o: John thanks you.
John thanked you.
John thanks me.
John thanked me.

q: Father said to me, "May you pass the examination." (Make it indirect)
o: Father prayed that I might be pased the examination.
Father hoped that I may pass the examination.
Father prayed that I might pass the examination.
Father said that might I pass the examination.
e: May you pass...-এর মতো প্রার্থনাসূচক optative বাক্যের indirect narration-এ reporting verb wish বা pray হয়, that বসে, তার পর new subject এবং may/might আসে। তাই Father prayed that I might pass the examination শুদ্ধ। বিকল্পে might I pass বা be pased-এর গঠন ভুল, আর hoped এখানে প্রার্থনার ভাব দেয় না।

q: Change the narration- She said to me, "Where do you live?"
o: She asked me where did I live.
She asked me where I lived.
She said me where I lived.
She asked me where do I live.

q: Evan said to me, "Let us go out for a walk." (make it indirect)
o: Evan proposed to me that we should go out for a walk.
Evan told me that we should go out for a walk.
Evan proposed that we should go out for a walk.
Evan said to me that we should go out for a walk.

q: Anwar said, ‘I have done the sum’. বাক্যটির indirect speech হবে-
o: Anwar said that I have done the sum
Anwar said that he had done the sum
Anwar said that I had done the sum
Anwar said that he has done the sum

q: Rahim said, "Hurrah! We have won the football game." (make it indirect)
o: Rahim exclaimed they had won the football game.
Rahim said that they had won the football game.
Rahim exclaimed with joy that they had won the football game.
Rahim exclaimed with joy that they were won the football game.

q: Choose the correct indirect sentence: He said, "Man is mortal."
o: He said man is mortal.
He told that man had been mortal.
He said that man was mortal.
He said that man is mortal.
e: Reported speech-এ চিরন্তন সত্য (universal truth) থাকলে reporting verb past হলেও তার tense বদলায় না। Man is mortal একটি চিরন্তন সত্য, তাই is থেকে যায়: He said that man is mortal। অর্থ: সে বলল যে মানুষ মরণশীল। Said-এর পরে that বসানোই নিয়মমাফিক রূপ। Told-এর পরে object ছাড়া that বসে না, আর was বা had been বসালে চিরন্তন সত্যের নিয়ম ভাঙে।

q: He said, "I must leave now." (Change the speech)
o: He said that he had to leave now.
He said that he must leave now.
He said that he has to leave now.
He said that he had to leave then.
